notes.title: Dragon Map Maker (Early Access) Update v0.241
notes.content:
[h2][b][u]Steam Early Access Build: V0.241[/u][/b][/h2]

[u][b][h3]Update highlights:[/h3][/b][/u][list]
[*] VTT lighting export
[*] 36 Language support for the DMM interface
[*] Native OS file browser
[*] Stone bridges and Castle wall themes
[/list]
[b][u][h3]Added Feature: .uvtt Lighting export.[/h3][/u][/b] The .uvtt file format supports importing of lights into VTTs. I’ve tested this in FoundryVTT and it does work quite well. It however will never look quite as good as a light in 3d and you may need to tweak light settings and light ranges once you’ve imported to the 2d VTT map. I’ve included some controls in DMM that should help you tweak your overall light export values for your VTT. Please keep in mind, light range values may be visually different in 3d vs 2d. A 3d light is a sphere while a 2d light is a circle. So the higher off the floor a 3d light is the smaller its light effect will look vs a 2d VTT where it will light up its whole range value.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/6a611bb5de2a45fe609b3e75840f937638d13c72.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/ae6b5321bda2099ed1ea5ec6e168e925d1d4b103.png[/img]

[b][u][h3]Added Feature: Full translation of the DMM app[/h3][/u][/b] DMM has been translated into 36 languages (interface, key mapping, theme names, theme override info text and theme search words). I’ve used Amazon Translate to do this as there was a massive amount of text to translate that wouldn’t have been possible to do manually. I hope it’s useful even though it may not be 100% perfect (some languages being worse than others).
[list]
[*] [b][u]Languages:[/u][/b] English, Afrikaans, Arabic, Bulgarian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Estonian, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hebrew, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Latvian, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Serbo Croatian, Slovak, Slovenian, Spanish, Swedish, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese, Hindi, Hungarian, Chinese Simplified, Chinese Traditional.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/6aafcf5fa0423cb891a4c8a37d57858fdd7ae7de.png[/img]

[b][u][h3]Added Feature: Set height and scale of the Objects Tool.[/h3][/u][/b] Adding the stone bridge assets into the Objects tool made me realise I needed a way to apply height and scale to Objects at a set value when Spawned or already on the map. You can now do this with the “Use Set values”, “Set height” and “Set Scale” options in the Objects Tool top bar.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/f9ebb447ed91d43a36967762adc2af88138333b1.png[/img]

[b][u][h3]Added Feature: Height Tool “Ignore Objects” Toggle.[/h3][/u][/b] Added a toggle to make height tools not affect objects placed with the “Objects Tool”. This is useful when editing height, when for example bridge parts or water have been placed above the terrain and need to stay at that height.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/ad43a52c091b74fdf8b2c8464e05d97d02ad2861.png[/img]

[b][u][h3]Added Feature: Native file browser support.[/h3][/u][/b] I’ve switched out the old file browser for a new version that should use your operating system file browser. If you have issues with this for any reason you can swap back to the old one by going to the bottom of the opinions panel and toggling it on.

[b][u][h3]Added UI: All Theme icons have been updated[/h3][/u][/b] Theme icons have been updated to match the icons in the Objects tool “theme icon window”. I also spent some time making the objects renderer in the Unity Editor work better so that when Steam Workshop support is added it’ll be a one click process to render icons to use in your themes.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/049f98e233f3060292ae08f44b4a2db6333f3186.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/1aa85992db8bb74a7157e56f63656369f92cc96b.png[/img][/url]

[b][u][h3]Changed UI: Tooltips[/h3][/u][/b] Cleaned up and corrected some tooltip text. In the process of adding translation I found some incorrect tooltip text. Also changed the key bind text in Tooltips to show as green instead of white making them easier to pick out. 

[b][u][h3]Changed UI: Buttons/Toggles[/h3][/u][/b] Updated UI elements such as Buttons and Toggles. Toggle buttons are now slightly rounded and have an indented look when clicked. While buttons remain squarer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/8c231634a08b03f986ab6cfed6395681839a3405.png[/img]

[b][u][h3]Added Assets: Stone bridges in the Objects Tool.[/h3] [/u][/b] You can use these parts to create stone bridges of any size. Use the new “Use Set Values” in the spawn tool to place them at the height and scale you need.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/25cc13ec56bb993f3279c6084d464c813857013a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/ca66fcf53de8f96dd563f52038d8d5e633740684.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/b8748e9082cb9623d5be773b13bc333e224d2312.jpg[/img]

[b][u][h3]Added Assets: Castle Walls, Doors and Windows.[/h3][/u][/b]These have a larger thickness to them. With two style variants and include single and double sided versions. (These are still a work in progress)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/c6f433a7870e5486f582f6bea7d61dda3f0ea8a8.png[/img]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/7190d3d190444354b8a8104107ce94ebeeea9727.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/7cf292d22aaf217ef40ade614c8824dc56abbc18.jpg[/img][/url]

[b][u][h3]Added Assets: Tokens and Symbols in the Objects Tool. [/h3][/u][/b]Found under “Decals”.
[list]
[*] Creatures
[*] Nature
[*] People Emojis
[*] People Pawns
[*] Places
[*] Shops and Businesses
[*] Symbols
[*] Weather
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/2679dbb014454c100e181507f31ca3062e25a661.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/691509a7f17e4e8fe9c4b5f2c489d712b430f9bb.png[/img]

[b][u]Bug Fix:[/u][/b] Some asset override values were not working. Fixed

[b][u]Bug Fix:[/u][/b] Turning on the Snow effect while in Orthographic camera mode or vise versa  would break DMMs camera rendering (everything would go white) and need a reload to fix it. I’ve not been able to get the Snow effect to work in orthographic mode so the snow effect will be turned off while in orthographic camera mode automatically and turned on again when Orthographic is turned off. Fixed

notes.title: Steam Early Access Build: V0.239
notes.content:
[h3]Map Saturation changes and controls:[/h3]
Last major update I added a more modern Terrain Shader. The new Terrain shader renders more realistically (it’s PBR now) and has more features, but it does render colors differently from the old terrain shader. This meant that on some biomes the colors and contrast were more muted and desaturated. After a bit of investigation I found that to get the same overall look as previous versions I’d need to increase the saturation of the camera post processing in DMM. 
So the result is, overall Saturation has been boosted a small amount to allow me to achieve more fully saturated colors in textures. After making this adjustment I went through all the textures and Biomes in DMM that looked a bit too saturated with the new settings and adjusted them so they match previous versions when rendered.
You may need to tweak your adjusted light colors and override colors you’ve added yourself on your maps if they now look a little too saturated. In practice I found the difference was not that noticeable unless dealing with already quite saturated colors. So you probably shouldn’t need to adjust much if anything. If you find any asset that now looks too saturated compared to its previous version give me a shout on Discord and I’ll take a look.

[b]Added UI/Feature:[/b] A new Color Saturation slider has been added to the “Render panel > Color Grading”. This value is saved per map like all the Color grading values are, the default is set at 8. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/3aac927757b37317a6dbcb847abede4a06f832a4.jpg[/img]

[b]Assets Tweaked: [/b]I went through and turned off the linework/outline effect for many assets that are meant to be low to the ground and look messy with an outline. For example, assets like the Decals and Hay as these looked weird when placed above a terrain that wasn’t 100% flat as outlines would appear where parts of the decals were too high off the ground.

[b]Tweaked Line rendering quality/width:[/b] I went and fiddled with the depth line width and render settings to try and get a slightly cleaner look. I believe this is better. I’ll add a slider to control this in the next patch. 

[b]Assets Adjusted for Wall Tool Fences:[/b] Fences in the wall tool are now built with only one pole per span. They now look a lot more naturel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/ab90acf988eba7554979157fe71e5143b5385830.jpg[/img]

[b]Added UI/Feature:[/b] Added an Exit App option for the file menu with a save map and save iterated map buttons. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/85b2780e8f5c25e0bdddcd2cd6284c4301656c71.jpg[/img]

[b]Bug Fix:[/b] When using the search feature in the Theme Library, if the first button was selected in the Theme Library before search and then the search replaced that button with a new one, the old button values were kept with some buggy theme list behaviour. Fixed 

[b]Bug Fix:[/b] Overrides would not save on certain maps. Fixed.
On maps with a large amount of themes added to the map theme lists, Overrides were not being saved reliably. If you have a map that has this problem and Overrides still don’t save correctly on it in this version. Select the theme button you want to fix and apply another theme to it then reapply the old one. The Override should now save correctly.

[b]Bug Fix:[/b] Duplicating theme buttons in a group when the group button was not visible caused the duplicated button to not be visible in the group until the group was closed and opened again. Fixed 
Note: Duplicated buttons will be created at the bottom if the group they are created in. These duplicated buttons are no longer automatically selected.

notes.title: Dragon Map Maker (Early Access) Update v0.238
notes.content:
[h2][b]Steam Early Access Build: V0.238[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Update Highlights:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] New Terrain/Biome Shader (Glowing (Lava) and metallic textures are now possible)
[*] Tweaked rendering to allow High dynamic range textures and effects like lava
[*] New Biome textures from floors
[*] See inside Multi-Object themes with the Theme Objects Icon window (Objects Tool).
[*] New written User manual on the web page [url=https://www.dragonmapmaker.com/howtomap]How To Map[/url]
[/list]
[h3][b]Change log:[/b][/h3]

[b][u]Unity Version Update:[/u][/b] The version of Unity which DMM uses has been updated from 2019 to 2022. Lots of stuff had to be changed and fixed under the hood, either bugs with Unity or systems that work differently in 2022. You shouldn’t notice any difference in basic functionality. It took longer than I wanted but now everything is working and updated (hopefully!) I can start to implement features that were not possible using 2019.

[b][u]Added new Terrain/Biome Shader:[/u][/b] A new terrain shader has been added now we’re in Unity 2022 that gives some new features.
Metallic surfaces
Glowing/Emissive surfaces (Lava etc)
Height blending between biome textures

[b][u]Added Asset:[/u][/b] Lava biomes
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/7a53fa4704cbfb83cbe4fb4d220b1e4c1f145d04.jpg[/img]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/af7abb8254e0595ccdf838de2ef69bbbe2e5d13a.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/e71db855d6a60d28ab0b3d2469ab0eafef53535d.jpg[/img][/url]

[b][u]Added Asset:[/u][/b] Biome textures from the Floors Tool. All the Floor Tool textures have been converted to be used as Biome textures! (its a lot of textures)
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/a325fbdf1ef2c78d1bf688a0cc2b86f1c3bc32c1.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/d73e42976d1dfeb476a58b3c6e2501ab2bc11360.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/1c72d3304b1bf323b2796b2ebb229e16e2b0570a.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/4380e4ec9466122cf79922c1403c1e6b520cb594.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/1319126a9b7644804888f0daecc9930af18c01dc.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/1b3ca57c6057ecc874e1414bfca9ea83308832cd.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/3bd9a653cc5d476e8a283f25b5b49ada4d004c61.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/3c7b9c79e957f7b94914e1d93c42f3a3cdd686c7.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/d3cfa3e817b7bc10e8bc9fe33d3428b9ba183713.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/bf8120e36dfbeb8f40fb9499aa6560b082f30bd6.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/7ccd674f9ae73886a459e24c43ee1b5bfce1ba05.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/18d5a6880985909c84d0f32eb25c7aac8954b4f3.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/54a0f33b88a90cc347c1a8636e11be909e626f4e.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/a6842bba144bda904a9ccca7dc0d88e9674a6787.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/42148a67117bc19f1fce098c84aa0b8fc8a5b225.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/020294ec37d668e66b71ff09167b2541022868ce.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/8f24bf13ca9c9c3987cda6c02bf786dfe5b079fe.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/6d7167e6e77e654533d17d3d300b9ee7181415c0.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/edf574dc86b00436adae69c4a92d0e8a9fd89e48.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/8e561b596ab793773d132d5ff585040691ff34ef.jpg[/img][/url]

[b][u]Added UI/Feature: Height Blend slider [/u][/b]for map terrain/biome textures. 
This value is saved with your map .dmm file and its default is set to 0.7. 
Biome textures will "hight-blend" together when they are not at 100% opacity in the painted layer mask and underlying biomes are visible through this. Each Biome texture now contains a height map. When two biome textures are blended together this height texture will effect how they blend. Higher parts of the biome textures get more weight than lower parts when blended. So a taller rock will be more visible than a lower patch of ground in a blended texture. 
Set the slider value to 0 to replicate the previous blending mode. 
This is a global effect and cant be controlled for individual biome layers.
I like the effect, it makes blended biomes look more natural but will change how they blend compared to the grid view.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/f6430f5336a41b59750da4897fd745ae12edcbb5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/fefd4d8abfb3e6349cc59e56e1986bc5db89a2f7.gif[/img]

[b][u]Added UI/Feature: Underground Biomes Height Control slider. [/u][/b]You can now control the top height of the Underground Biomes. Currently this is a global setting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/b83d1882f7c2c5bf7465a5e50d336cf4d9964bd2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/cb087fdd106937e8c0149959e0d73ee2a3788c63.gif[/img]

[b][u]Added UI/Feature Objects Tool “Multi Object” peeking window: [/u][/b]A window showing what a Multi-Object Theme contains has been added. Open the "Theme Objects" window using the button found on the side of the Map Theme List for the Objects Tool. Clicking on an “Object Icon” will change the selected objects or “Spawn Tool” example object to the relevant object clicked. You can peak into Multi-Object themes in the Theme Library without loading them as well! Just remember what ever you clicked last will be displayed, so its possible to have the window open on a theme that is not on your map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/37a0ec4b2c9cdd344dddc8dce5a2a6a247df9aa0.jpg[/img]

[b][u]Map Rendering Speed:[/u][/b] If you’re using the cap frame rate feature in the Options panel you should notice a small to large speed increase when rendering a map (depending on your GPU speed) as the frame cap is now disabled when the map renders. The frame capping was having a much greater effect on map rendering speed than it should have...

[b][u]Lighting Panel:[/u][/b]
[b][u]Added UI: Time of Day buttons.[/u][/b] Reset time of day button and buttons to set commonly needed times (These have been set to give the best looking lighting angles for each time of day).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/8cb99793dee59b0afa613d7c1df06c837b6902ea.jpg[/img]

[b][u]Added UI:[/u][/b] Reset Sun-Moon Direction

[b][u]Minor UI changes:[/u][/b]
[b][u]Changed UI : [/u][/b]“Object Themes” tool text to “Object Theme Markers” to make naming of tools more consistent.
[b][u]Changed UI: Help window.[/u][/b] Now points to the Tutorial page of our website [url=https://www.dragonmapmaker.com/howtomap]How To Map[/url] (which was also updated)
[b][u]Added UI: Eraser Icon. [/u][/b]Added to Terrain Icon in Floors tool list to make the function of this theme a little clearer (it’s used to erase rooms!).
[b][u]Changed UI: Changed the color scheme of the file browser so its easier to read.[/u][/b]

[b][u].uvtt export:[/u][/b]
[b][u]Added UI/Feature Fix: Version number for FoundryVTT export. [/u][/b]The FoundryVTT import module “Universal VTT Importer” by moo_man has changed how it deals with Portals (doors and windows) which can affect DMM cropped maps. Make sure what ever version of FoundryVTT you are using that you’ve updated the module as well. Then choose the version of FoundryVTT you are using in the .uvtt export tab. If your windows and doors are offset or missing you’ve clicked the wrong version. (FoundryVTT v10 = module v2.6 and FoundryVTT v11 = module v3.0)

[b][u]New Bridge and Fence Assets:[/u][/b]
[b][u]Asset Added:[/u][/b] New wooden bridge objects. Added to Floor (Used with the Height > Sticky Room tool) and Object tools.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/af8c7e8cfbd2ae4283b238a07c4d9c0bc58353c0.jpg[/img]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/cefba15020f3cff5ab3a809f701ee40fa1afd7b9.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/bcbe987e7d481f9f8d8da0ea7c66f8e5601f4656.jpg[/img][/url]

[b][u]Asset Added: [/u][/b]New wooden fence objects. Added to Wall and Object tools.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/0794da976e7a8c6cf9c0f4fc16853d637b5e913b.jpg[/img]

[b][u]Help/Tutorials:[/u][/b]
[b][u]New written “User manual” and “Quick Start manual” as Google Docs [/u][/b](meaning you can translate them as well). Find them here [url=https://www.dragonmapmaker.com/howtomap]How To Map[/url]. People have often requested a written user manual and tutorial as some people don’t like learning using the video tutorials. It was quite a bit of work but these are now in a good state and explain 95% of the features of DMM. In addition they should be quite quick to update in the future!

[b][u]Index for Web video tutorials:[/u][/b] I added an index for the web video tutorials on the Dragon Map Maker [url=https://www.dragonmapmaker.com/howtomap]How To Map[/url] web site. Click on a heading to be taken to that video.

[b][u]Bug fix:[/u][/b] Color picker window when opened for the first time could be outside the screen bounds on certain screen aspect ratios and UI sizes. Fixed
[b][u]Bug fix:[/u][/b] If the scaling of the UI is not close to the standard 1920x1080 (1.0) dragging biome layer buttons line indicator may not line up on the lower half of the button. Fixed
[b][u]Bug fix:[/u][/b] Fancy Wood Wall had the wrong shader applied to certain parts: Fixed
[b][u]Bug fix:[/u][/b] Stairs Objects kept highlight turned on when switching out of the objects tool: Fixed

notes.title: Dragon Map Maker (Early Access) Update v0.236
notes.content:
[h2][b]Steam Early Access Build: V0.236[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Update Highlights:[/b][/h3]
I’ve added a [b]Crop Map Tool[/b], find it in the render panel. It allows you to[u][i] render out any sized map[/i][/u] you want (yay!). It means you don't really need to think about the exact map size until you’ve got a map ready to render. It's much more flexible this way and doesn’t restrict the user. Crops both Rendered map images and .uvtt files.

[h3][b]Change log:[/b][/h3]

[b][u]Bug Fix: [/u][/b]Light slider values were not affecting light values when the value was typed into the text box below the sliders. Fixed.

[b][u]Bug Fix: [/u][/b]DMM would complain if the Webp option was selected in the .uvtt save options and a larger than 12k render was attempted even if a .uvtt wasn’t being saved. Fixed.

[b][u]Bug Fix: [/u][/b]Resizing the map canvas (which clears the undo stack) would delete duplicated objects if they were still contained in the Undo command stack, causing DMM to break. Fixed.

[b][u]Added DPI metadata to Jpg/Png (for printing):[/u] [/b]When a .JPG or .PNG map is rendered the DPI metadata (Dots Per Inch) of the image is now inserted to reflect the chosen DPI in the render panel. Allowing these images to be printed at the correct scale (1 inch per square) without having to set the DPI at print time or having to use another piece of software to set the DPI for printing. 

[b][u]Added UI Color change for Map/.uvtt file save panels:[/u] [/b]Panels now change color when map image save or .uvtt save is selected making it more easily readable at a glance. 

[b][u]Tweaked Overide UI:[/u] [/b]Some of the Overide UI text didn’t clip nicely when the UI window was scaled. It should be more readable now.

[b][u]Increased the accuracy of the basic Cursor:[/u] [/b]The basic mouse cursor pixel click point was adjusted to make selections more accurate.

[b][u]Map Canvas Naming:[/u] [/b]The map you paint and place objects onto is now referred to as the “Map Canvas”. 

[b][u][u]Added Map Crop Tool:[/u][/u] [/b]When the tool is active you can drag the Crop Map Tool gizmo to the desired map size. This allows you to select parts of the map canvas to render out, allowing rectangular maps of any aspect ratio. This turned out to be a much more flexible way of creating maps than specifying a map size at the start of map creation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/762a9717a1ab3231364b9753677711a52afdb3de.gif[/img]

[b][u]Added Orthographic Camera (Experimental):[/u] [/b]In the top bar Camera controls you can now switch the view camera between Perspective and Orthographic modes. While in Orthographic mode there is no perspective so you can more easily see what the final map image may look like from above when you reset the camera. Also useful to line up the Map Crop Tool more easily on hilly maps (the main reason I added this in this update).
 **Warning: Due to Unity Orthographic cameras not supporting some rendering options certain effects and shaders will not render correctly (water and tree leaves for example).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/7f04e275c3ff634fd8c1661490fa5621a51d8f00.png[/img]

[b][u]Added .uvtt file Multiple Underground/Cave biome walls:[/u] [/b]If the map has more than one Underground/Cave layer the .uvtt saver will now make walls for all of them not just the first layer it finds.

[b][u]Added VTT UI buttons:[/u] [/b]VTT buttons have been added to the .uvtt render tab for the big three VTTs. These have tooltips with more information on how to export to each VTT. Clicking them will take you to external web pages relevant to the VTTs .uvtt implementation (Fantasy Grounds (v4.4+) now has an integrated .uvtt loader so that button just takes you to their main web page).

[b][u]Added better quality soft shadows:[/u] [/b]Substantially improved the look and quality of shadows, the soft shadow option now makes them much softer. Helps with soft light sources like torches and fires. 

[b][u]Added Assets Egyptian/KingKik style objects:[/u] [/b]A new set of objects has been added in the style of a Royal Egyptian house. These objects will go along with the Kickstarter Hero Tier objects. The shader allows the color of the metal to be changed from gold to any color metal using the Color Override.

[b][u]Added Assets New Royal/Temple/Ornate patterned tiles:[/u] [/b]A selection of tiles in the styles of Royal/Temple/Ornate have been added. These will go great in many maps and include Fancy, Grimey and Ruined variations.

[b][u]Added Plane color assets:[/u] [/b]Added objects similar to water planes that have simple color shaders.

[b]Object Tool[/b]
[list]
[*] Color: a colored plane that receives lighting and shadows. 
[*] Color Flat: a colored plane not receiving any lighting or shadows but will be the color set.
[/list]
[b][u]Added Hole assets:[/u] [/b]Added objects that can be used as holes. These will also act the same way room floors act on the terrain, removing grass and other objects under them and creating a hole below them. You can indent them deeper into the terrain as well to get a slightly sloped side as seen in the image below. The Terrain deformation doesn’t happen in real-time, “Update” the map to see the result.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/8b496e26ae2b060679a996c404ad4a1719ae8365.png[/img]

[b]Object Tool[/b]

[*] Rock: Rocky rubble piled around the hole. 
[*] Mud: Softer muddy clumps around the hole.
[*] Planks: Can be used on wooden floors to show broken planks. Match the floor color with the Color Override. 
[*] Broken Planks: A variation of the planks hole but with added splintered wood surrounding the hole.
[*] Holes: Just the holes by themselves with no surrounding assets.
[/list]
[b][u]Added Assets New Simple White tiles:[/u] [/b]A set of White tiles that can be coloured using the Color Overide and their size changed using the Material Overide to be used with the pattern tiles and include Fancy, Grimey and Ruined variations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/1dd0b45ad7cb1b3fff50d1ec1690525937882e55.png[/img]

[b][u]Tweaked FireFlame asset: [/u][/b]The Fire Flame Light asset in the Object tool has had its point light moved up more above the fire flame to allow the light from the fire to spill out a bit further giving a more ambient look to the light.

[b] [u]Added Mirrored Spiral Stairs asset:[/u] [/b]Added a mirrored Spiral stair asset.

[h3]Happy mapping folks![/h3]

notes.title: Dragon Map Maker (Early Access) Update v0.235
notes.content:
For help videos go to [url=https://www.dragonmapmaker.com/howtomap/]https://www.dragonmapmaker.com/howtomap/[/url]
Join the Discord server to ask questions and share your maps by clicking the Discord button at the top right of the interface (or in the Steam Store info section).

[b]Update Highlights:[/b]
[list]
[*] New grid snapping and rotation stepping options for the [b]Objects Tool[/b].
[*] Improved transform Gizmos (Move, Rotate and Scale) so they are easier to use.
[*] Select a Theme using an object selection in the [b]Objects Tool[/b].
[*] UI improvements.
[/list]
[i]plus Minor Asset updates and Bug fixes in this update.[/i]

[b]Steam Early Access Build: V0.235[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Added Rotation Stepping: [/b]The [b]Object Spawn tool[/b] and the [b]Rotation[/b] tool (both found in the [b]Objects Tool[/b] toolbar) now have rotation stepping (45-degree steps). The default key for rotation stepping is “Shift” but this can be changed in the Key mapping menu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/cf37a5a21ebd1af887ecfb8123d2ae1d7c11c19f.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/583a29bafaaca9460c029ea8bacc15c0f050ad63.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Added Grid Snapping: [/b]The [b]Object Spawn tool[/b] and the [b]Move tool[/b] (both found in the [b]Objects Tool[/b] toolbar) now have grid snapping (None, Centre, Edge and Corner). Access Grid snapping using the new Toggles in the [b]Objects Tool[/b] Toolbar.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/a503ef4525ba60d3d389eb95a0f34a7b4a7393ba.png[/img]

[*] [b]Changed: [/b]Move, Rotation and Scale Gizmos ([b]Objects Tool[/b]) are now easier to select and drag with larger colliders around them optimised to reduce miss-clicks. They will also now stay visible while in camera mode but not be selectable until camera mode is exited.

[*] [b]Added UI Toolbar Expand/Contract separators: [/b]Some toolbars with a large numbers of buttons/toggles etc now have collapsible separators so the user can hide items they are not using.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/6daaf87fcd140e3f277cbef1fbb0abf2b472bccd.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Added UI Toolbar Scrolling: [/b]Some toolbars with large numbers of buttons/toggles etc now are able to be scrolled with the mouse wheel or dragged with a mouse click if they get too long for the current UI size.
[*] [b]Moved Gizmo Toggles: [/b]The "Gizmo visibility Toggle" has been moved to the top bar so the user doesn’t have to go into the [b]Objects Tool[/b] to turn floating icon gizmos on/off.
[*] [b]Added Square Biome brush cursor: [/b]When painting with the square biome brush the brush cursor is now a square.

[*] [b]Added Double click to open/close Theme Lists: [/b]Double click a theme button in the map theme list to open and close that tools Theme List.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/9dc4833a70ac2766253a935f06034aba8086dce8.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Added “Select Theme from object selection” Button (Objects Tool): [/b]To find what theme an object belongs to in the [b]Objects Tool[/b] select an object in "[b]Select All[/b]" mode and click the “[b]Theme select button[/b]” in the toolbar. The theme button the object belongs to will be selected in the Scene theme list.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047366/acc6f7a6b348f21a4e61b336fa2de743db966ef7.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Added Scroll to new button: [/b]Scene Theme Lists now scroll to new buttons when they are added. 

[*] [b]Added Asset Unrolled bedroll: [/b]An unrolled bedroll had been added to the [b]Objects Tool[/b] (this was in the previous build but wasn’t in the patch notes).

[*] [b]Changed: [/b][b]Object Theme Tool[/b] themes that need a wall to spawn have had a wall theme Icon Overlay added to their theme icons.
[*] [b]Changed: [/b]Objects Tool theme “bar tables” have had extra metadata added so they will show up in searches e.g. tavern, pub alehouse.

[*] [b]Fixed: [/b]Some “Light Objects” in the [b]Objects Tool[/b] didn’t have the correct overlay icon showing they had a light embedded inside them. Fixed.
[*] [b]Fixed bug: [/b]Reset Rotations button in the [b]Objects Tool[/b] didn’t reliably reset rotation on the rotation Gizmo (Visual only). Fixed.
[*] [b]Fixed bug: [/b]If the Camera mode button was something other than Spacebar transform Gizmos for the [b]Objects Tool[/b] were still visible and still selectable in camera mode. Fixed.
[*] [b]Fixed bug: [/b]Undo was not saved for the “Objects Tool” if camera mode was entered while a transform Gizmo was being dragged. This also caused a selection error. Fixed.
[*] [b]Fixed: [/b]Kitchen Cleaver in Objects Tool was to tall. Fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Dragon Map Maker (Early Access)
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome to Steam early access! [/h2]

For help videos on each tool and how it's used click on the tutorials button in the top right of the interface or go to [url=https://www.dragonmapmaker.com/howtomap/]https://www.dragonmapmaker.com/howtomap/[/url]
Join the Discord server to ask questions and share your maps by clicking the Discord button at the top right of the interface (or in the Steam Store info section).

[b]Update Highlights:[/b]
[list]
[*] New Input System - Assign keys to most functions.
[*] Better Tooltips and Help Bar - linked to the input system showing your current key mapping.
[*] Brush Size with Scroll wheel - Hold B to change brush size with the mouse Scroll Wheel.
[*] New Screenshot feature - Go to the “render tab/screenshot mode” and take screenshots of your map.
[*] Theme Lists - can now be dragged out to make them bigger.
[/list]
[h3]Minor Asset updates, Bug fixes and new Quality of Life features in this update.[/h3]

[b]Steam Early Access Build: V0.233[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Fixed bug:[/b] Roofs were getting taller or shorter depending on what height they were on. Fixed, they stay the same height now.
[*] [b]Fixed bug:[/b] Overides were not being applied when the map was loaded if the theme was in a group in the theme list. Fixed.
[*] [b]Fixed bug:[/b] Live update brushes would be recorded when the update map keyboard shortcut was pressed. Fixed.
[*] [b]Fixed bug:[/b] Ice rocky structures didn’t have the correct override for it’s color. Fixed.
[*] [b]Fixed bug:[/b] Using the Swap camera shortcut key would leave data on the map if a live updating tool is over the map. Fixed.
[/list][list]
[*] [b]Asset: [/b]Added tables with no chairs in the Objects Tool and Theme Marker tool.
[*] [b]Asset:[/b] Sakura/Cherry blossom tree textures. I added a cherry blossom tree texture to the birch trees and Oak trees. Find it in the Overide for its texture.
[*] [b]Asset: [/b]Sakura/Cherry blossom trees I added a cherry blossom tree set to the Object Tool.
[/list][list]
[*] [b]New feature: Assign your own Keys.[/b] Keys can now be assigned to your hearts content. Find it in the options menu or the top bar. Check the assigned keys here as well. (It's a whole new input system so please report any input bugs).
[*] [b]New feature: Change brush Size with Mouse wheel.[/b] I added the ability to use a key+mouse wheel to change the size of brushes. I may add the ability to just use the mouse wheel but will have to adjust a few things to make that not clash with other features.
[*] [b]New feature: Screen Shot Mode.[/b] I added a simple screenshot mode to the render panel.
Screenshots are saved to the map folder and are named using the name of the map plus an iteration number.
It will not save over previous screenshots.
There’s a folder icon to open the map folder and an arrow button to collapse the effects panel so you can see the full screen view.
Currently it saves HD .jpg images (1920x1080).
I added a fun TiltShift effect for this mode (makes things look miniature).
[*] [b]UI New feature: Change the Size of Theme lists.[/b]  You can now drag theme lists out to see the longer theme names!
[*] [b]Added: Snow effect warning message.[/b] You’ll now get a warning if you turn on the Snow effect without assigning a snow Biome (hopefully this will stop some confusion for first time users).
[*] [b]Added UI Folder shortcuts[/b] for the save and data dir. In the save menu you can now click on the folder icons and open up the save directory in windows. There's also a button to open the data directory that DMM is installed in. Just in case anything goes wrong with the save. These are a first test of a new file system that uses native OS file windows instead of the generic one that DMM uses at the moment.
[*] [b]Added Better Tooltips. [/b]All tooltips are now linked to the new input system, allowing them to show the current key assigned.
[*] [b]Updated Help bar.[/b] As with the tooltips I had to remake the bottom tool help bar. It now shows the current keys assigned to each tool. If you don’t want to see it just toggle it off with the toggle button on the bars far left.
[/list]
